name: Stanly Ranch, Auberge Collection
positioning: Wellness-focused ranch resort of cottages on a historic Napa Valley vineyard estate, with the Halehouse spa and the Bear restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want wellness, cycling and outdoor experiences alongside wine country
Families looking for a more active Napa stay

facts.text: The property was founded in 1856 by Judge Edward Stanly.
The resort has Napa River frontage adjacent to the San Pablo Bay Estuary.
The cottages were designed by the architectural firm Overland Partners.
Basin Bar sits beside the swimming pool, with an outdoor dining area in a lavender-scented grove.
Family experiences include farm tours, hot air balloon rides and falconry.
The resort has a dedicated family pool.
The resort's vineyards are all organically grown.
The resort also offers Vineyard Homes and Villas for purchase.
Downtown Napa is 10 minutes away and Sonoma is 20 minutes away.

highlights.text: The Springhouse Circuit at Halehouse includes a hyperbaric oxygen chamber, tepidarium, salt room, cold plunge bath and cedar sauna.
Bear serves multi-course dinners paired with wines from its cellar.
Guests can travel off-road in a Land Rover Defender to a library wine tasting at Quintessa.
The hotel has a local cycling club that guests can join for group rides once a week.
The cottages have outdoor showers, yoga mats, meditation cushions and Theragun massage devices.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to nearby attractions.
The resort is a 50-minute drive from the Bay Area.
